# Testing

Authoritative directory: `src/test/java/powerband/` (mirrors the main packages). Only `MainTest` exists.
Use JUnit 5. Name tests `<ClassName>Test.java`. Run with `mvn test`.
Run `update-current-development` after each feature to refresh this map.
